CFML Language Reference: Functions

FileExists

Checks whether the given absolute path names an existing file on the server.

Category

System functions

Syntax

FileExists(absolute_path)

Parameters

absolute_path
The full path of the file. Use ExpandPath to build one from a relative path.

Returns

YES if the file exists, NO if it does not or if the path names a directory.

Usage

A good habit before CFFILE ACTION="Read" or "Delete", which throw an exception when the file is missing. To check for a directory, use DirectoryExists.

Example

Opens the example in a new window. The example runs on this server, so it only works when you browse from the server itself (127.0.0.1).
<CFSET Files = "Application.cfm,fileexists.cfm,missing.cfm">
<TABLE BORDER=1 CELLPADDING=3>
<TR><TH>File</TH><TH>FileExists(ExpandPath(file))</TH></TR>
<CFLOOP LIST="#Files#" INDEX="f">
<CFOUTPUT><TR><TD>#f#</TD><TD>#FileExists(ExpandPath(f))#</TD></TR></CFOUTPUT>
</CFLOOP>
<CFOUTPUT><TR><TD>#GetTempDirectory()# (a directory)</TD><TD>#FileExists(GetTempDirectory())#</TD></TR></CFOUTPUT>
</TABLE>

See also

DirectoryExists, ExpandPath, CFFILE, GetTempFile
